caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse positioned in profile, facing left. The horse is predominantly colored in various shades of brown, with the main body, head, and neck rendered in a medium brown tone, while the legs, tail, and seat feature a lighter brown color. The rockers beneath the horse are curved and appear reddish-brown, with visible wood grain texture. The horse has simple carved features, such as ears, eyes, nostrils, and a short, upright mane. A wooden seat is integrated into the back of the horse, with a small backrest extending upward. The saddle area and the lower parts of the rockers have slightly darker, reddish hues. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the brown tones of the horse and emphasizing the detailed wood textures and joints in the structure.
title: Rocking Horse
